_about: Jean-Jacques Rousseau (1712-1778): the Confessions, complete in twelve books, from Gutenberg (privately printed for the members of the Aldus Society, London, 1903; translator not named in the book). The Social Contract and Discourses (Cole, PG 46333) are on the Adler shelf, Emile on rousseau-emile, and Eloisa on singles-fiction-3; none is taken again. No uids minted. Added 2026-10-17: the Discourse on Inequality in the anonymous translation of PG 11136, a different translation from the Adler shelf's Social Contract and Discourses (PG 46333).

rousseau-confessions-1903: The Confessions of Jean Jacques Rousseau, complete (London: Aldus Society, 1903)
rousseau-discourse-on-inequality: A Discourse upon the Origin and the Foundation of the Inequality among Mankind (the etext names no printing; its introductory note matches the Harvard Classics, inferred)
